issues.issue: Does subsection 42(1)(b) of IRPA apply to the Applicant as a permanent resident accompanying family member?
issues.applicant_position: Subsection 42(1)(b) does not apply to Applicant as permanent resident; applies only to foreign nationals excluding permanent residents.
issues.respondent_position: If Applicant's father found inadmissible, Applicant would be inadmissible as accompanying family member under subsection 42(1)(b) of IRPA.
issues.result_text: Subsection 42(1) likely does not apply to Applicant as she is a permanent resident, excluded as foreign national.

issues.issue: Is the Applicant inadmissible due to indirect misrepresentation under subsection 40(1)(a) of IRPA based on father's misrepresentation?
issues.applicant_position: Minister's submissions on constructive misrepresentation lack evidentiary support and are speculative; only section 42 investigation exists.
issues.respondent_position: If father found inadmissible for misrepresentation, a section 44 Report will be made against Applicant leading to admissibility hearing and likely exclusion order.
issues.result_text: Applicant inadmissible for indirectly making father's misrepresentation under subsection 40(1)(a) IRPA.

issues.issue: Should the Court entertain the Respondent’s new submissions on subsection 40(1)(a) despite being raised late?
issues.applicant_position: Court should not entertain new submission on section 40 as separate ground; evidence shows sole ground is section 42.
issues.respondent_position: No certified question needed; admissibility proceedings on misrepresentation render Applicant inadmissible per Wang decision.
issues.result_text: Court required to entertain Respondent’s new submissions despite harsh consequences.

issues.issue: Is the Wang decision applicable and good law for interpreting indirect misrepresentation under subsection 40(1)(a) IRPA?
issues.applicant_position: Applicant challenges Wang's applicability in further submissions.
issues.respondent_position: Wang decision supports inadmissibility for indirect misrepresentation and is applicable.
issues.result_text: Wang applies and supports inadmissibility for indirect misrepresentation in this matter.

issues.issue: Is the Applicant entitled to a writ of mandamus compelling the Respondent to complete citizenship processing?
issues.applicant_position: Applicant seeks writ of mandamus to compel processing of citizenship application.
issues.respondent_position: Respondent suspended processing pending admissibility hearing; lawful under section 13.1 of the Act.
issues.result_text: Application for writ of mandamus dismissed; processing lawfully suspended pending admissibility hearing.
